description: Tracked release inputs, mandatory direct-evidence gates, and publish-binary coverage. A bundled component is releasable only when every required field is exact and reviewStatus is reviewed.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Complete Import through Export production workflow succeeds offline with the CPU provider and enhancement disabled.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: No approved OCR detector, OCR recognizer, marker-center payload, or arrow/bracket/legend/intersection mask provider currently completes the production workflow.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: The ignored Chandler case passes the fixed automatic-detection acceptance contract without training or tuning exposure.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Automatic production detection is fail closed until all required model tasks and the checksum-bound artifact-mask provider are approved.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Correction replay, save, reopen, autosave, recovery, CSV export, and audit export pass with production results.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Manual workflow evidence exists, but production automatic-result replay and persistence evidence does not.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Born-digital and scanned-PDF panel imports reach the same production detection, review, and export workflow.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: The exact reviewed renderer passes local backend execution and a procedural scanned-page import into a real workspace tab, but common-publish, clean-machine, and complete downstream detection, review, and export evidence are incomplete.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Image and batch imports use production detection, preserve completed work, and cancel safely.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Production orchestration now checkpoints each fully reviewed panel atomically, retains completed panels when a later panel is cancelled, and resumes to a complete result in direct executable test composition. The gate remains blocked because no approved packaged OCR and marker-center payload set can provide end-to-end production batch evidence.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Keyboard-only operation and UI Automation names pass across the complete production workflow.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Existing control-level tests do not constitute complete production-workflow accessibility evidence.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: The fixed public production scoreboard passes with approved packaged model payloads and real adapters.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: The current public scoreboard is a synthetic metric-contract smoke and is not production model evidence.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: The exact reviewed source-built OpenCvSharpExtern binary loads and passes application smoke on a clean Windows machine.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: The retained passing record is historical: runtime 87c12460 and portable 0.0.21. It does not validate the newly source-reviewed c96f91b3 runtime. Fresh evidence must bind the current runtime, application, version, commit, and harness before this gate can pass.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: The exact minimal PDFium renderer and its complete runtime payload load and render on a clean Windows machine.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: The exact reviewed minimal PDFium renderer rendered a controlled PDF and the packaged application fallback exited 0 in the same fresh offline Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation VM.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: The workflow passes with enhancement disabled and with the exact reviewed optional enhancement runtime enabled.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: The external development runtime is not an approved packaged production payload.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Installer install, launch, repair, upgrade, uninstall, offline, CPU fallback, path, diagnostics, and mutable-state scenarios pass on clean Windows.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: No complete clean-Windows installer scenario evidence is sealed.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Portable extraction, launch, offline workflow, CPU fallback, path, read-only diagnostics, registry independence, and mutable-state scenarios pass on clean Windows.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Development portable smoke is not complete clean-Windows production portable evidence.

mandatoryEvidenceGates.description: Installer and portable are produced from one clean common publish with identical application, contract, model, manifest, notice, and SBOM bytes.
mandatoryEvidenceGates.notes: Artifact emission remains disabled while mandatory production, model, provenance, and VM gates are blocked.
